description: Route leak detected involving AS 45489. Analysis of AS relationships shows abnormal triplets: 1) 7642 (provider) -> 45489 (customer) -> 24016 (provider) violates valley-free routing (customer-to-provider followed by provider-to-customer). 2) 6894 (peer) -> 6939 (customer) -> 7642 (provider) shows peer-to-peer leak. The legitimate origin AS 24016 remains unchanged, confirming this is not a prefix hijack.
